g.text: Production Defect Intelligence Platform • Bayesian Hazard Scoring • pgvector RAG Citations • Sub-50ms Change Token Engine
Loads reviews by CSV or adapters (db adapters connect to any db), normalize them into one schema
and dedupe them with SHA-256 fingerprinting (Amazon Reviews, CPSC, Support Tickets).
Multi-layer regex & safety taxonomy for critical hazard terms (burn, spark, fire, battery burst)
plus 14-day defect frequency spike detector comparing against historical baseline.
Bayesian hazard severity scoring (0-100 scale) prioritizing dangerous anomalies
and predicting recall hazard windows 4-12 weeks before official regulator action.
NVIDIA NIM LLM generates grounded answers strictly citing retrieved review IDs [R-EXT-*]
with strict refusal of ungrounded speculation or hallucinated claims.
Compiles natural language rules into temporal directives; dispatches real transactional emails
via Resend API and JSON incident payloads to Slack webhooks upon severity threshold breach.
Unified useLiveData hook polls composite change token every 4.5s; automatically updates
Overview, Risk Queue, Alerts, and header badge without manual page reload.
Preserves scroll position, active filters, page selection, and modal inputs.
GET /api/v1/system/changes resolves in <1ms from in-memory cache (2.0s TTL), bypassing
database roundtrips on cache hits; queries indexed counts only when expired.
Strict 5-second timeout on all outbound network calls (Resend, Slack, NVIDIA NIM LLM).
Outbound timeouts fail soft without crashing pipelines or aborting database transactions.
Backtesting and lead-time simulations strictly mask all reviews after the simulation date,
preventing future data contamination from artificially inflating historical performance.
Single polling loop per browser tab; consumes only 230 bytes per poll (~3.0 KB/min).
Pauses immediately when tab is hidden (Page Visibility API) to eliminate wasted battery/bandwidth.
On network failures, polling interval backs off gracefully (4.5s -> 8s -> 14.5s -> 26s -> 30s max);
dashboard header shows 'Reconnecting…' and resumes instant synchronization when online.
Zero hardcoded secrets; environment-driven credentials; append-only audit_log table
records all rule creations, manual evaluations, exports, and automated alert deliveries.
Strict database connection pooling and CORS origin isolation.
